pages.text: A Cursed Energy Core's material is decided by the fluid injected during the ritual (the melting recipes from fluid → material). Core parts are tallied by their $(bold)head$(), and only the material's $(bold)default traits$() (default) apply — armor-exclusive traits (perStat: armor) never appear on cores.$(br2)There are ten usable core materials in total; click each one to see its $(bold)acquisition$() and $(bold)innate traits$():$(li)$(l:materials/material_ashen_ink)Ashen Ink$() (T3)$(li)$(l:materials/material_dragonbone)Dragonbone$() (T1)$(li)$(l:materials/material_dragonsteel_fire)Dragonsteel Fire$() (T3)$(li)$(l:materials/material_dragonsteel_ice)Dragonsteel Ice$() (T3)$(li)$(l:materials/material_dragonsteel_lightning)Dragonsteel Lightning$() (T3)$(li)$(l:materials/material_dreadsteel)Dreadsteel$() (T4)$(li)$(l:materials/material_durandal)Durandal$() (special)$(li)$(l:materials/material_gheloth_remains)Gheloth Remains$() (T4)$(li)$(l:materials/material_hastur_malice)Hastur's Malice$() (T2)$(li)$(l:materials/material_nicholas_blessing)Life Impulse$() (T3)$(br2)For the effects of each material's traits, see the $(l:traits/trait_overview)Combat Traits$() chapter.
